newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BON ACCORD LOSE AGAIN BUT IT'S SO MUCH BETTER THAN 36-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BON ACCORD LOSE AGAIN BUT IT'S SO MUCH BETTER THAN 36-0.

text.p: Bon Accord fared somewhat bon Sunday than they had done more than a century ago when they suffered a British record 36-0 defeat.

The minor league club, who were hit by an avalanche of goals when they met Arbroath in the Scottish Cup in September 1885, lost just 4-0 when they took on the same opponents to mark the opening of their new ground.
Bon Accord were at a distinct disadvantage 111 years ago when they turned up for the match with nine men and had to recruit two stand-in players from the crowd.
They kept with tradition on Sunday by fielding nine regulars plus two guests -- Motherwell manager Alex McLeish and former Scotland captain Willie Miller.
